XD-17.note: Both gold and my initial blind answer missed a controlling exception: LAFPP p25 Section1.22 says comply with standard City provisions 'except for the following' and expressly lists PSC-36 Iran Contracting Act. Its generic appendix p42 contains the $1m affidavit clause, but it cannot be presented as an unqualified respondent obligation for this RFP. Illinois SRS, NYC BERS and SC RSIC impose the identified Iran provisions. Preserve LAFPP as a document containing an exempted clause, not a fourth operative requirement.

proposed_changes.gold_answer: Illinois SRS actuarial consulting requires the Disclosure of Business Operations with Iran (Vendor Disclosure Part6). NYC BERS 2024-003 requires the Iran Divestment Act compliance rider and bidder certification concerning the SFL165-a list. SC RSIC 2016 general consulting requires ExhibitF Iran Divestment Act of 2014 certification and advice consistent with the applicable investment restrictions. LAFPP DCFS25-01 also contains a generic PSC-36 Iran Contracting Act affidavit clause for City contracts estimated at $1m or more in its appendix, but Section1.22 of the RFP explicitly EXEMPTS PSC-36; it should not be counted as an applicable Iran affidavit obligation under this solicitation.
